chains.title: HOXB13 binds the ref T allele more and activates RFX6

links.claim: HOXB13 binds the ref T allele more strongly than the alt C allele at rs339331; QBiC-SELEX coverage is not_checked.
rs339331 lies in a prostate-active intronic enhancer in RFX6, and the ref T allele increases enhancer activity.
The ref T enhancer increases RFX6 expression.
The effect is observed in prostate epithelial/LNCaP cells.
Higher RFX6 increases prostate cancer risk at 6q22.

predictions: HOXB13 binds the ref T allele more than the alt C allele
The ref T allele increases enhancer activity in prostate cells
RFX6 expression is higher with ref T
The risk-associated ref allele increases prostate cancer risk via higher RFX6
falsified_if: HOXB13 does not bind rs339331 allele-specifically
Ref T does not increase enhancer activity or RFX6 expression
HOXB13 knockdown does not affect RFX6
